hook: TIMS-Alwal: *90%* done in Jan 2025, *95%* done now, says BRS
fact: TIMS-Alwal hospital was called *90% complete* in January 2025 and *95%* this week.
twist: The January 2025 announcement promised the hospital would be fully running by August 31, 2025.
tldr: BRS leader Manne Krishank, quoting two ministers' statements, says only five per cent of work moved in nearly two years.

beats.what: Health Minister Damodar Rajanarasimha visited on Nov 10 and said 95% of work was done and it would open soon.
beats.why: BRS says R&B Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy had announced 90% completion in January 2025.
beats.care: The hospital is meant to serve north Hyderabad, including Alwal and Cantonment.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Krishank also cited delays at TIMS Sanathnagar and the Warangal super-speciality hospital.

cards.q: What should the government share about TIMS-Alwal?

qs: What does the remaining 5% of work involve, and who sets the new opening date?

facts.t: In January 2025 the hospital was to be fully operational by *August 31, 2025*.

viz.verdict: Progress claims 22 months apart; opening still pending
Deadline passed; new date not announced

watch: Whether the government announces a firm opening date for TIMS-Alwal.
